correctness.rationale: Wild Riemann–Hurwitz gives genus 8 and Deuring–Shafarevich 3-rank 2; two pole valuations give exactly eight regular basis forms x^i dx (−3≤i≤1), x^j y dx (−2≤j≤0). Cartier on x^-1 dx and x^-1 y dx fixes both; C(x^-2 y dx),C(y dx) modulo fixed plane yield 2×2 block [[1,a^(1/3)],[b^(1/3),λ^(1/3)]]. Determinant (λ−ab)^(1/3) shows ranks 4/3; C² image fixed plane hence rank2. Independent symbolic determinant/semilinear reasoning and inspection of exact F9 checker support the result. The jump divisor is smooth since ∂(ab−λ)/∂λ=−1.
